tasks.sql:
WITH school_scores AS (
  SELECT cds, CAST(NumGE1500 AS INTEGER) AS qualifying_students
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S' AND NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
), top_schools AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN school_scores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE t.qualifying_students = (SELECT MAX(qualifying_students) FROM school_scores)
), administrators AS (
  SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, AdmLName1 AS last_name, 1 AS slot FROM top_schools
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AdmFName2, AdmLName2, 2 FROM top_schools
  UNION ALL
  SELECT AdmFName3, AdmLName3, 3 FROM top_schools
)
SELECT first_name, last_name
FROM administrators
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(first_name)) NOT IN ('', 'none')
  AND LOWER(TRIM(last_name)) NOT IN ('', 'none')
ORDER BY slot;
